prompt_example:
ArsMovieStill, movie still from a 1970s technicolor Sci-Fi movie.
A highly realistic cinematic photograph of a confident woman with short platinum blonde hair styled in an asymmetric cut, wearing a sleek futuristic black and metallic uniform with gold and silver armor-like panels, a high collar, and a red cape draped over one shoulder. Her outfit combines sci-fi and military fashion with a white belt and gold accents, tailored to perfection. She stands in a commanding pose with one hand on her hip, gazing forward with a cool, determined expression. The scene takes place in a futuristic sci-fi environment   —  a sleek metallic command deck with holographic displays and soft blue ambient lighting. The atmosphere feels dramatic and high-tech, with shallow depth of field, cinematic lighting, and subtle lens flare for realism and mood.
